Your iPhone's Photos app already does what most paid editing apps charge for.
 
#1 Clean Up erases strangers from the background
#2 Extend widens a tight shot
#3 Reframe changes the angle after you took the photo
#4 Portrait photos let you change the blur and the focus later
#5 The Crop dial fixes crooked shots and perspective
#6 Copy edits from 1 photo and paste them onto the rest
#7 The Lock Screen tucks the clock behind your subject
 
Clean Up, Extend and Reframe need iOS 27 with Apple Intelligence.
 
Which one did you not know about? Save this for the next time an app asks for $9.99 a month, and send it to someone who still pays for one.

7 things the new Siri in iOS 27 actually did on my iPhone.

#1 It reads your screen and names what's on it
#2 Siri in the Camera identifies anything you point at
#3 It knows your plans and tells you when to leave
#4 It acts inside your apps, like building a photo album
#5 It saves anything on screen into a note
#6 It searches Mail and Messages together
#7 It finds photos by what's in them

Save this so you remember to try them. Needs iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 16 and later.

iOS 27 lets you turn Liquid Glass off. Settings> Appearance> Liquid Glass. Drag left for clear, right for fully tinted. Tinted is the one that makes text readable again on a busy wallpaper. It applies system-wide, so every app follows it. Save this. #iOS27 #iPhoneTips #Apple #LiquidGlass
